Hi James — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround.

Quick clarifying question: is the US EIN registered to a US legal entity ("OrbitCloud Solutions, Inc." / an employer identification number for a US corporation) or is it an EIN issued to a US branch of the UK company? For Redwood's PO/payment flow our vendor portal and ACH setup require a W-9 from a US taxpayer entity. If your US EIN maps to a separate US-registered entity, please confirm the legal name that matches the EIN exactly.

If the EIN is for a US branch of the UK entity and you do not have a separate US-entity W-9, then W-8BEN-E is appropriate but we will need additional substantiation about withholding status (and the PO will stay in review until Finance confirms tax-treatment).

I'll loop in Finance to advise on acceptable evidence.

Best,

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-01T13:23:00-04:00
Subject: RE: OrbitCloud tax docs and PO onboarding

Alex / Grace — reviewed the attachments. Short summary and recommended path: 

1) EIN evidence: the attached "OrbitCloud-EIN-letter.pdf" looks like an IRS EIN confirmation but it lists the name as "OrbitCloud US Branch" (not a separate incorporated US entity). That suggests the EIN is for a US branch of the UK parent, not a distinct US corporation.

2) Form provided: W-8BEN-E is the correct form for a foreign entity claiming treaty benefits or indicating foreign status. If OrbitCloud's payments will be made to the UK entity, we must store the W-8BEN-E and apply appropriate withholding rules.

3) If OrbitCloud prefers Redwood to treat payments as to a US entity (to avoid withholding), they need to supply a W-9 signed by that US legal entity that exactly matches the EIN record. Typical acceptable docs: (a) signed W-9, (b) IRS EIN letter showing the same named entity, or (c) a Certificate of Incorporation + EIN letter tying the name to US entity.

4) PO status: move to "pending tax". We can provision a limited PO while tax evidence is under review for a pilot payment method (wire vs ACH), but final PO approval & ACH auto-pay require the W-9 + matching EIN.

Action items for Alex to send to vendor: ask them to confirm the legal entity that will receive funds, and either: (A) if funds go to the UK entity, confirm W-8BEN-E is acceptable and provide completed withholding rate declaration; or (B) if they want US-entity treatment, provide a signed W-9 and entity formation docs that match the EIN name.

I'll attach the procurement pre-check checklist which lists what Finance needs for PO activation.

Monica Patel
Finance — Vendor Payments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-po-precheck.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-02T08:41:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Tax ID verification — OrbitCloud onboarding & PO pre-check

Hi James — thanks again for the files. Per Finance's review (copied) here are two short options so we can proceed to PO activation: 

Option A — Payments to UK entity (OrbitCloud Solutions Ltd)
- Provide the signed W-8BEN-E (you already attached one; please confirm the signatory and date).
- Confirm the payee name you want on the PO ("OrbitCloud Solutions Ltd"), and whether you accept any applicable withholding.
- Expected outcome: PO can be created and routed as "non-US payee"; payment timing may require manual review and withholding handling.

Option B — Payments to US entity (to avoid withholding)
- Provide a signed W-9 that exactly matches the entity name on the IRS EIN letter.
- Provide a certificate/articles of incorporation for the US entity if the name alone is ambiguous.
- Expected outcome: once W-9 + EIN match, Finance will clear ACH setup and PO moves to Active.

To keep the pilot moving, we can provision a limited PO in a "pending tax" state to allow service kickoff while you finalize docs. If you'd like that, say so and we will provision with a $25k cap and wire-only payment until tax is confirmed.

Please reply with which option you choose and attach the requested document. If convenient, you can also upload to our vendor portal (link below) or sign via DocuSign.

Vendor portal: https://vendors.redwood.com/upload/OrbitCloud
DocuSign link (one-click): https://docusign.com/embedded/abc123

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if it'd help.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Sourcing Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0142
